jobs.title: People Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days, not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

With over $100M in TCV secured within 12 months, and a new $50M Series B led by Highland Europe, Unframe is rapidly scaling globally alongside Fortune 500 customers, backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV.

About the role

We’re looking for an People Operations Lead to help shape how we grow - as a team, as a culture, and as a company. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments and enjoys partnering closely with managers and employees. You'll combine strategic thinking with operational excellence, ensuring our people processes scale alongside our business.

This is a hybrid role, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys working in person and can join the team in our office a few days each week.

What you’ll do

- Partner closely with managers and team leads across EMEA and the US to support team growth, performance, and employee development.

- Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle for our global workforce, from offer stage and onboarding through development and offboarding, partnering closely with Employer of Record (EOR) providers.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on people-related matters in a global, cross-cultural environment.

- Lead and continuously improve core HR processes, including performance reviews, feedback cycles, goal setting, and talent planning.

- Coach and support managers through complex employee relations and people challenges across multiple geographies.

- Drive initiatives that enhance employee engagement, company culture, and the overall employee experience across distributed teams.

- Ensure People operations, policies, and processes are scalable, compliant, and aligned with business needs as the company grows.

What we’re looking for

- 8+ years of experience in an HR Business Partner, People Operations, or similar role.

- Experience supporting globally distributed teams, with a strong understanding of US employment practices and work culture.

- Experience managing global employment through Employer of Record (EOR) providers, including onboarding, employee lifecycle management, and compliance.

- Experience working in a high-growth startup or other fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable collaborating across multiple time zones.

- Native-level fluency in English, both written and spoken.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across cultures and organizational levels.

- Proven experience coaching managers through performance, organizational, and employee relations challenges.

- High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting as priorities evolve.

- Experience with organizational development, leadership coaching, or talent management is a plus.

Why join us

We’re a small, product-focused team building AI-powered solutions, moving fast and working closely together.

This role is an opportunity to shape how we grow and have real impact on people, culture, and the way we build.

jobs.title: VP, Partnerships & Alliances
jobs.description:
VP, Partnerships & Alliances

About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

With over $100M in TCV secured within 12 months, and a new $50M Series B led by Highland Europe, Unframe is rapidly scaling globally alongside Fortune 500 customers, backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV.

About the role

We’re hiring a VP of Partnerships & Alliances to build and lead Unframe’s partner ecosystem as a core growth engine for the business.

This is a high-impact leadership role at a pivotal stage. You will define how Unframe scales beyond direct sales, turning partnerships into a consistent driver of pipeline, POCs, and revenue.

From day one, you’ll be expected to generate momentum: activating existing relationships, creating new paths to pipeline, and identifying high-impact opportunities with partners. At the same time, you’ll shape the long-term strategy deciding where to focus, which partnerships matter, and how to build a repeatable, scalable motion.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, working directly with Sales, Product, and executive leadership to define how we win through partners in the enterprise. This is not a maintenance role. It’s an opportunity to:

- Build a category-defining partnerships motion in AI

- Create new revenue channels from the ground up

- Shape how enterprise AI is delivered through ecosystems

What you’ll do

- Drive partner - sourced pipeline: Activate existing partners and create near-term opportunities through co-sell motions, joint accounts, and targeted use cases

- Define global partnerships strategy: Prioritize across SIs, hyperscalers, and channel partners, alliances, and more, focusing on where Unframe can win and generate pipeline quickly, while laying the groundwork for long-term strategy

- Recruit and activate strategic partners: Identify and close high-impact partnerships while ensuring they produce pipeline and ultimately revenue

- Develop / enable repeatable co-sell motions: Build partner-specific plays tied to high-impact use cases and enterprise entry points aligned to their needs

- Scale the function: Hire and lead a partnerships team, defining structure, metrics, and performance standards

- Drive revenue : Drive pipeline generation and closed revenue through partner-led and partner-influenced deals

- Partner cross-functionally: Align closely with Sales, Product, and RevOps on pipeline, POCs, and partner attribution

- Travel frequently: Represent Unframe in partner and customer meetings and industry events (30–40%)

What we’re looking for

- 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or indirect GTM within enterprise software

- Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue through partners

- Experience working with SIs, hyperscalers, or channel ecosystems in complex enterprise sales environments

- Strong enterprise sales instincts, comfortable influencing complex early-stage deals

- Experienced global leader with a track record of building and scaling high-performing, distributed teams

- Strong understanding of complex technical products and how to position them effectively within partner ecosystems (CIO, CTO, data/AI stakeholders)

- Builder mindset with experience creating partnership programs from zero and operating effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Why join us

- Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives tied to pipeline and revenue impact

- High-visibility leadership role shaping Unframe’s growth strategy

- Opportunity to build a core revenue engine from the ground up

- Direct access to founders and executive leadership

jobs.title: VP People
jobs.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in total funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally.

About the Role

As our VP People , you’ll own the entire employee lifecycle and play a key role in shaping how we support, develop, and scale our people globally. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building strong people practices while partnering closely with managers to create high-performing teams.

You’ll be the go-to partner for managers and leaders across the organization, helping them navigate performance, employee relations, leadership development, and organizational challenges. You’ll also own the operational side of the employee experience, ensuring every stage of the employee lifecycle is consistent, thoughtful, and aligned with our culture across the company.

What You'll Do

- Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle globally, from onboarding through offboarding.

- Work in close partnership with the recruiting team to accelerate hiring, streamline recruitment processes, and proactively remove obstacles throughout the hiring lifecycle.

- Partner closely with managers on performance management, employee development, promotions, compensation cycles, and day-to-day people decisions.

- Coach managers on leadership best practices, feedback conversations, performance improvement, difficult conversations, and employee relations.

- Design and deliver manager enablement programs and leadership training for both new and experienced managers.

- Lead annual and ongoing performance review processes, ensuring consistency and high-quality execution across the organization.

- Drive employee engagement initiatives and continuously improve the employee experience and strengthen our company culture.

- Support organizational changes, team effectiveness, and people-related decision making.

- Identify trends and organizational challenges using people data and recommend practical solutions.

- Build and scale global People processes, ensuring consistency while adapting where needed to support teams across different locations.

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of experience in HR, People, or HRBP roles within fast-growing technology startups.

- A hands-on mindset with the ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and operational execution.

- Demonstrated experience leading an HR and/or Talent Acquisition function.

- Previous experience supporting managers and leadership teams in a high-growth environment, ideally across multiple locations.

- Proven experience leading performance management, employee relations, and organizational processes.

- Experience coaching managers through complex people situations with confidence and sound judgment.

- Strong knowledge of Israeli employment law and HR best practices.

- Experience designing and facilitating manager training programs is a significant advantage.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable working independently and building processes from the ground up.

- Fluent Hebrew and English.

Why Join Us?

Join Unframe at an exciting stage of growth, where you'll have the opportunity to build and lead our global HR function. You'll partner closely with leaders across the company, shape how we scale our people and culture, and have a direct impact on the next chapter of Unframe's growth.
